title: no post in the window has been captioned by the vision path yet (the routing flip landed 2026-09-21)
evidence: 34 render(s) imported in the last 7 days, and 0 post(s) in that window were written by the vision path; corpus 339 photos / 141 attached, newest attachment 2026-05-28. PostAutomation::GenerateCaption used to branch on photo.image.attached?, and Growth::ContentGenerator#import_photo creates photos path-only, so every production caption was written from the photo's context text: measured 2026-09-21, the text path described 'rain drumming on the windowpane ... chamomile tea' for a render that shows an autumn street scene with a mug, which the vision path described correctly. THE BRANCH WAS FLIPPED 2026-09-21 (commit f37136e): it now routes on CaptionGeneration::ImageEncoder.readable?, so a path-only render with a resolvable file takes the vision path -- verified live on photo 353 (generator='vision', gemma3:4b, caption grounded in the image). The attachment count in this evidence is therefore NO LONGER the condition; it is kept only as the count of renders still being produced. The one remaining condition is the second clause: no post in the window has yet been captioned by the vision path. This record closes itself on the next rendered post (measured cost on the live caption host: 15.0s for a 1.1 MB render through gemma3:4b).

The sequencing IS the decision: a vision model describing a minor-reading render makes the persona problem worse, so the persona must read adult first. In-repo half already landed (f55e8ae); the flip is the one-line branch change in PostAutomation::GenerateCaption.

FLIPPED 2026-09-21 (operating agent). The sequencing condition (the persona's age reading) is satisfied by the persona-age-read-youthful fix: the render prompt now states an adult age and the pre-publish age gate HOLDS any render whose read comes back juvenile, so a vision model describing the image can no longer amplify a minor-reading render.
